SOUTHEAST RESOURCE RECOVERY
  FACILITY (SERRF) AGENDA
  TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 1, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  WILLMORE CONFERENCE ROOM, 11TH FLOOR, 11:00 AM

DIRECTORS  ALTERNATES
Keir Jones, Chair  Steve Croft, Alternate
Cindy Allen, Vice Chair  Tina Hansen, Alternate
Kristina Duggan, Board Member  Megan Kerr, Alternate
Daryl Supernaw, Board Member  Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, Alternate
Jeff Wood, Board Member  Mary Zendejas, Alternate

Robert Dowell, General Manager
Jane Hermsen, Secretary

  Members of the public have the option to email public comments to
  Jane.Hermsen@longbeach.gov

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55959  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Southeast Resource Recovery
  Facility (SERRF) meeting of March 19, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55960  Recommendation to authorize General Manager, or designee, to execute all
  documents necessary to enter into a contract with Silverado Contractors, Inc. of
  Chino, CA, for the demolition of SERRF, in the amount of $4,977,800, and
  authorize a 15 percent contingency in the amount of $746,670, for a total contract
  amount not to exceed $5,724,470, with a reservation of all rights by the City and
  the Sanitation District.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

CHAIR AND VICE CHAIR ELECTION

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Southeast Resource Recovery Facility (SERRF) on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Vanessa Hall, City Clerk Specialist, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.
